lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank in a semi-regular grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of spots to form higher-contrast nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
